AlertEntryDTO.description:
One flagged page/query. `clicks_previous`/`delta_pct` are `None` for
a `new` entry (no previous-period row exists) — never a fabricated `0`
or `inf` (PLAN §12).
AlertEntryDTO.title: AlertEntryDTO

AlertsResponseDTO.description:
`GET /clients/{id}/alerts` response.

`declining`/`rising`/`new` are sorted by absolute click impact, never by
percentage (PLAN §21.5: a 5000->4000 drop outranks a 20->10 one).
Period dates are the exact calendar ranges `resolve_periods` resolved,
always present regardless of whether data exists for them — so the UI
can show "insufficient data for 6-12 January" instead of a blank state.
`skipped_reason` is set (with all three lists empty) when either period
carries `partial`/`truncated` data or has no stored data at all — a
false alert is worse than no alert.
AlertsResponseDTO.title: AlertsResponseDTO

CellStatus.description:
Status of one `(client, provider)` collection cell (PLAN §9.1/§9.2).

`not_configured` is terminal and distinct from `failed`: the integration
was never set up for this client, nothing was attempted, and it must
never be rendered as a failure or as zero. It is also distinct from
`unavailable` (attempted, provider has no data) and `auth_required`
(configured, but the session/credentials expired).

`awaiting_auth` (task-21) is **not terminal**: a live session check (or
an adapter reporting `error_code="auth_required"`) found the session for
this provider dead. The cell is parked here — releasing its browser
profile lock and stopping its lease clock, since neither `claim_next_cell`
nor startup recovery watch anything but `running` — while its lane waits
for the operator to log back in, then auto-resumes by requeuing this same
cell. It only ever becomes terminal (`failed`, `error_code="auth_required"`)
if the wait times out.
CellStatus.title: CellStatus

ClientHealthDTO.description:
Composite performance signal for a client card (PLAN §21.2).

`value` is `None` — never `0` — when no service contributed. `coverage_*`
is shown alongside it so the operator can tell "72% · 3/4 services" apart
from a client that only has one service configured at all.
ClientHealthDTO.title: ClientHealthDTO

DateRange.description: Inclusive date range; the UI always renders the exact start/end.

DimensionAnalyticsResponseDTO.description:
`GET /clients/{id}/analytics/{pages,queries}` response.

`truncated` is derived from the stored rows' own `quality`, not
inferred from row count, so a caller can never mistake a short-but-
complete list for a cut one (PLAN §12: truncated must never pass as
the full list). `total_rows_available` is the pre-cap count for the
matched period, independent of this response's own `limit`/`offset`.

DimensionRowDTO.description:

MetricTrendDTO.description:

never a fabricated 0%" rule) without the composite-specific coverage
bookkeeping, so other card widgets — e.g. GBP website clicks — can reuse
the same delta-arrow/sparkline UI the health block already draws.
MetricTrendDTO.title: MetricTrendDTO

PeriodKind.description:
Comparison period (PLAN §3.1, §21.1).

`week`/`month` are the dashboard's base periods. `quarter`/`year`/`custom`
were added by task-14 and are computed **by aggregating already-stored
history** (zero new collection), so they are only available where the UI
honestly shows coverage — on the client page (§21.1/§21.6), not on the
main dashboard.

post.description:
Перевірити сторінку **без кешу** й зберегти вердикт.

Запит іде з рандомним cache-buster-ом і `no-cache`-заголовками, бо в
клієнтів кілька шарів кешу. Це зменшує, але не прибирає ризик edge-кешу —
тому UI показує час перевірки й прямо про це попереджає.

Прийняти таблицю аудиту як сирі байти тіла запиту.

Без `multipart/form-data`: файл один, інших полів у формі немає, тож
multipart нічого не дає, зате вимагав би залежності `python-multipart`
(той самий вибір, що й `upload_logo` в `api/clients.py`). Імʼя файлу —
заголовком `X-Filename`, воно потрібне лише для показу й підказки формату.
